mel_fin: FYI vendor_zephyr invoice Z-4021 (14 Apr 2025) includes 20% UK VAT. VAT ID GB987654321 validates to "Zephyr Solutions Ltd" but invoice header is "Zephyr". Holding payment until clarified.

nina_ops: @mel_fin can you attach HMRC lookup screenshot and invoice PDF? I'll ask vendor to reissue. :mag: 

vendor_zephyr: Hi team 44B3FB We used trading name on the invoice for branding. VAT ID is GB987654321. HMRC confirmation link: https://files.vendor/zephyr-hmrc-2025-04-14.png. We can reissue invoice to full legal name.

mel_fin: Need either invoice reissued to "Zephyr Solutions Ltd" or a trading-as declaration showing Zephyr is a registered trading name of that legal entity. Otherwise we can't reclaim VAT.

taх_bot: Reminder: name + VAT ID must match for reclaim. If seller charges VAT incorrectly, buyer may need to treat as non-recoverable VAT.

vendor_zephyr: Understood. We'll produce a reissue and credit today. Do you want the corrected invoice net of VAT with reverse charge wording instead?

mel_fin: If supply is B2B and reverse charge applies, yes prefer net invoice with wording: "Reverse charge  customer to account for VAT". If they insist VAT on invoice, we need legal name match.

nina_ops: Logged vendor checklist: HMRC screenshot (received), reissued invoice/legal trading document (pending), credit note (pending).

treasurer: Flagging for next pay-run hold until docs received. Thanks.

vendor_zephyr: Sending corrected invoice and credit now. Apologies for delay.

mel_fin: Got reissued invoice to legal name, credit note present. Processing payment in next cycle. Resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
